# paperclip_project_lead (Resource)

Owns a project's native leadAgentId after the project and agent exist. Import by project ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_project_lead" "core_lead" {
  project_id = paperclip_project.core.id
  agent_id   = paperclip_agent.lead.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Native agent assigned as project lead.
- `project_id` (String) Project receiving the lead assignment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project ID identifying this assignment.
